text:
Alex W: Hey team — quick sync: we need to lock the weekly oncall handoff + triage call cadence. Proposed: Mon/Wed/Fri 09:30 PT, 30m. Purpose: quick handoff, open incidents review, and any escalation checklist updates. Agenda draft below, pls confirm who must attend (SRE, infra, product on rotation?).

Priya S: +1 on cadence. Can we make one session strictly for handoff (10m) then the rest for triage? Keeps it sharp.

Jon K: Works for me. Suggest we add a rolling owner for the triage notes and action items — 1 person to file follow-ups.

Sara L: I can take notes this week. Also want the escalation matrix reviewed — last week there was confusion on page timing.

Carlos M: If possible shift to 09:00 PT on Wed only — we have a recurring infra stand at 09:15 Wed that conflicts. Other days fine.

Alex W: Good call Carlos — okay how about Mon/Fri 09:30, Wed 09:00? If ok I'll update the calendar invite.

Priya S: That works for me.

Jon K: fine from my side.

Sara L: ok.

Alex W: Draft agenda (copy into calendar invite):
```
1) Handoff (5-10m) — outgoing oncall summarizes overnight alerts / mitigations
2) Open incidents quick review (10-15m) — status, blockers, required escalations
3) Escalation matrix & timing (5m) — who gets paged after X mins
4) Action items & owner assignment (5m)
```

Alex W: Who should be on the escalation attendance list by default? Current suggestion: SRE lead (Priya), Runtime eng (Jon), Platform infra (Carlos), Product ops (Sara). Add anyone?

Carlos M: Add me for infra. For high sev (>P1) we should page the oncall engineering manager too (cc @Alex W).

Priya S: Agree. Also propose that if an incident is >30m unresolved we auto-escalate to the rotations' secondary. We should codify in the triage doc.

Jon K: I'll update the triage doc after the call with the new escalation timing.

Sara L: Reminder: please bring the most recent runbook links to the call. I'll drop them in thread beforehand.

Alex W: Will update invite + add agenda. Calendar link: https://calendar.company/meet/weekly-oncall (please accept).

Ops Bot: NOTE: Weekly oncall invite updated by Alex W — Mon/Fri 09:30 PT, Wed 09:00 PT. Guests: Priya S, Jon K, Sara L, Carlos M.

Incident Bot: ALERT: INC-2026-04 opened (rate-limit surge, queue growth). Assigned to oncall.

Priya S: Acknowledge INC-2026-04. I'll triage now and update in the call.

Alex W: Thanks — final ask: confirm rotation checklist items we want in the invite so new oncall can follow:
- Slack channel: #oncall
- PagerDuty runbook link
- Triage doc link
- Escalation matrix (who to page and when)
- Postmortem template

Jon K: Add: "How to abort a rollout" quick link (for runtime rollbacks).

Sara L: I'll assemble a 1-page checklist and post here by EOD.

Carlos M: thumbs up :thumbsup:

Alex W: Great — if no objections I'll finalize the invite and agenda by 17:00 PT today. Otherwise drop comments here.

Priya S: No objections from SRE.

Jon K: All good.

Sara L: Good to go.

Alex W: Thanks everyone. See you on the call.
